name: Otyugh
languages: telepathy 120 ft. (doesn't allow the receiving creature to respond telepathically)

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description:
The otyugh makes one Bite attack and two
Tentacle attacks.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 5 ft. Hit: 12 (2d8 + 3)

actions.name: Piercing damage, and the target has the Poisoned condition
actions.description: Whenever the Poisoned target finishes a Long Rest, it is subjected to the following effect. Constitution Saving Throw: DC 15. Failure: The target's Hit Point

actions.name: maximum decreases by 5 (1d10) and doesn't return to normal until the Poisoned condition ends on the target
Tentacle
actions.description:
Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 10 ft. Hit: 12
(2d8 + 3) Piercing damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 13) from one of two tentacles.

actions.name: creature Grappled by the otyugh
actions.description: Failure: 16 (3d8 + 3) Bludgeoning damage, and the target has the Stunned condition until the start of the otyugh's next turn. Success: Half damage only.
